links.outcome: Readability of LLM chatbot responses to optic neuritis questions on four readability scales
links.effect: All responses from the four LLM chatbots required at least university-level reading proficiency, which is above typical patient reading levels.
links.quote: Note that all responses require at least a university-level reading proficiency.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of LLM performance (accuracy, comprehensiveness, readability) on optic neuritis medical questions evaluated by expert ophthalmologists, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
